notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.1.3 Version Update
notes.notes:
- The balance related to endings has been adjusted. You can now experience endings linked to the progression of education and event triggers.

- Optimization and performance speed have been improved. Issues where the game wouldn't run on certain graphic cards have been resolved.

- New story content has been added. Discover the newly hidden storyline!

- Trigger conditions for certain events have been adjusted, making it easier to encounter more events.

notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.0.36 Version Patch Notes
notes.notes:
ꉂ☻ᵎᵎᵎ Hey, my dear brothers and sisters! 
I've made something special so we can have even more fun together! 
Come take a look, hehe. 

[Content Addition]

1. A total of 130 teaser events and light events for the story and existing events have been added.
2. A bulletin board has been added to the village, providing a total of 76 pieces of information that can be checked every month.

[Feature Addition]

1. A UI displaying the monster's name and HP when attacking a monster is now available.

[Event Balance and Bug Fixes]

1. Events that were not linked during the event have been fixed.
2. The activation conditions for the Charmant Social Event have been lowered.
3. The conditions for the Revolutionary Army Leader ending have been lowered.
4. The combat power of NPCs encountered in adventure areas has been slightly lowered.

[Other Changes]

1. About 20 new cutscenes have been added to the endings and events.
2. The Companionship Book for NPCs who have seen the social ending will now be permanently open.

Love you all, MUAH! 😘💋💋

notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.0.32 Version Patch Notes
notes.notes:
ꉂ☻ᵎᵎᵎ Hey, my dear brothers and sisters! 
I've made something special so we can have even more fun together! 
Come take a look, hehe. 

[Event-Related Balance Adjustments]
1. We have lowered the activation conditions for specific events in adventure areas.
2. The rewards for events related to certain skills have been increased.

[Job Ending Balance Adjustments]
1. The overall point value for job endings has been increased.
2. We have slightly raised the difficulty for the conditions of private ending.

[Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed an issue where some achievements were not being completed.
2. Fixed an issue where sound was not being applied in some dialogues.
3. Corrected awkward transitions in Jack's social interactions.
4. Fixed an issue in the companionship book where birthdays were listed twice.

[Other Changes]
1. Now, when using an item in the inventory that changes your character's state, the character's motion will immediately reflect the new state.
2. The UI for the "Companionship Book" that can be accessed in the town has been updated.
3. Added a feature to complete missing job-ending achievements in the "Album View" menu on the title screen.

Love you all, MUAH! 😘💋💋

notes.title: Memories: Millennium Girl 1.0.30.ver Patch Notes
notes.notes:
ꉂ☻ᵎᵎᵎ Hey, my dear brothers and sisters! 
I've made something special so we can have even more fun together! 
Come take a look, hehe. 

[Event-related Balance Adjustments]

1. Fortune Cookie Event
   - Reduced the required amount of gold.
   - Decreased the stat reduction if you get a 'miss.'

2. Flower Watching Event
   - Increased the chances of it occurring.
   - Removed the cooking stat increase and gold decrease from rewards.

3. Cold Winter Event
   - Slightly increased the probability of this event occurring.
   - Increased the fatigue reduction amount.

4. Summer Vacation Event
   - Removed the gold requirement.

5. Ice Cream Event
   - Reduced the gold requirement.

6. Fortune Teller Event
   - Reduced the gold requirement.

[Schedule Balance Changes]

1. Reduced the amount of stat reduction in most schedules.
2. Increased the energy consumption reduction when learning theology.

[Bug Fixes]

1. Fixed an issue where a black screen appeared on some devices.
2. Fixed an issue where interactions in the village were not working.
3. Fixed an issue where conversations with your younger sister were not progressing.
4. Fixed an issue where some sound effects were not playing.
5. Fixed some awkward scripts.

[UI Improvements]

1. Gold requirements will now be displayed in choice-based events that require gold.

Well then, let's meet again soon in a better environment! You should come and see me quickly! 

Love you all, MUAH! 😘💋💋
